description: This file is a part of the vtiger CRM system responsible for selecting email-related information for entities like Accounts, Leads, and Contacts. It handles fetching specific fields from the database based on user permissions and prepares data to be rendered in a Smarty template for email selection.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class extension used for rendering templates within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security vulnerabilities such as SQL injection.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves the tab ID associated with a module name in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getFieldVisibilityPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view a specific field in a module.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Fetches the translated label for a field label in the current language context.
